CDS does not report an SAT composite 25/50/75 (only EBRW and Math), so sat_composite is null. Penn has a single ED round (11/1) and no EA. C7 rates test scores only 'Considered' for the Fall 2025 cohort, while C8A (Fall 2027) and the admissions site say SAT/ACT are required; the C7 rating probably reflects the earlier test-optional period. C1 enrolled line has a stray '13' printed near the part-time males row; full-time males (1,133) + females (1,287) = 2,420, which matches the reported total. Unknown-sex applicants (17) are included in the 72,544 total. Deadlines page says the cycle is for fall 2027 entry; RD Jan 5, 2027.

test_policy_2026_27: Test-optional through the 2026-27 admission campaign (Class of 2031); SAT/ACT required for homeschooled applicants
notes: CDS index: https://www.villanova.edu/university/provost/odsdi/external-survey-reporting.html (file version v3). C21 gives one ED figure; ED I (11/1) and ED II (1/15) look combined. C22 confirms EA (closing 11/1, notification 1/20, not restrictive) but the CDS gives no EA applicant or admit counts, so those fields are null. C8A marks SAT/ACT 'Required for some' (homeschool students, per C8F); for everyone else it is test-optional. Enrolled 1,805 includes 16 part-time students (1,789 full-time). Only 19% of enrollees submitted SAT and 9% ACT, so the score ranges describe a small subset. The deadlines page does not name the entry term; the admissions page names Class of 2031 (2026-27) for the test policy. Admissions pages say EA applicants may switch to ED I by Nov 10, and deferred EA or RD applicants may switch to ED II by Jan 31.
